name: Scanning Made Easy
description:
We get it; The early-game of Thaumcraft requires a lot of research and you don't want to throw every one of your 1000 items on the ground and scan them for aspects. That's why we added 2 cool QoL features which makes this tedious task very quick and easy.

1. You don't actually have to throw the item on the ground. You can scan it directly from your inventory! Simply hover your Thaumometer over the item you want to scan, and after a short duration it will be scanned.

2. You've probably accumulated dozens of double chests full of junk that you don't want to sift through and scan, so there's a second feature now: Scanning entire chests! Simply shift right-click while hovering over a chest with your thaumometer and it'll scan EVERY item inside of the chest. Though before you can do so you have to learn a bit more about deconstruction in the Thaumonomicon.

[note]Hint: To unlock the research to scan entire chests, go to your Thaumonomicon, open "Basic Information" (the first tab), and complete this research path: Research -> Research Expertise -> Deconstruction Table -> Container Scanning.[/note]
